ValidationRule.description: If the Opportunity is already at Stage 5 (not being changed to Stage 5) or at Stages 6 or 7, ensure that the Booked Date cannot be changed except by the listed Profiles on the specified record types.Booked Date is now first bill date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(CloseDate) && (ISPICKVAL(StageName , '7 - Closed') || ISPICKVAL(StageName , '6 - Setup') || (ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in') && NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)))) && ( $Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IME_In_Country_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IME_SC_Account_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IME_Contracts" && $Profile.Name <> "IME_JV_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IMAP_In_Country_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IMAP_SC_In_Country_Admin+" && $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_In_Country_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IMLTD_In_Country_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_Custom Sys" && $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_In_Country_Admin+" && $Profile.Name <> "IM_API Only_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "AS NCSP Coordinator" && $Profile.Name <> "AS NCSP CSA" && $Profile.Name <> "AS NCSP Management" && $Profile.Name <> "Contract Admin NA" && $Profile.Name <> "AS_Ops User" && $Profile.Name <> "IM_Sales_Ops-Cleanup Temporary" && $Profile.Name <> "IM_Sales Ops Super User" && $Profile.Name <> "IM_Sales Ops Super User_Kimble" && $Profile.Name <> "IMAP_SC_In_Country_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IME_SC_In_Country_Admin" && $Profile.Name <> "IM_Super_User" && $Profile.Name <> "IME_Super_User") && (RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDei" || RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDeh"|| RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDec")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once the Opportunity has been Closed Won by reaching Stage 5 or beyond, you cannot make further changes to the Close Date.
